desc:
🌊 WOAH! Something is lurking underneath the ocean. Drink the ocean to find treasures, and learn the secret of the waters.

🥤 Start with a straw (that's it)
🎒 Upgrade your jug to drink more
🧃 Buy better and better straws
👟 Upgrade your speed, sell value, & more
🪙 Uncover treasures underneath the ocean floor
⛵ Purchase fast powerful boats the suck up water faster
🤝 6 Player Lobbies
⏳ Drink up the entire ocean!

Have fun? Be sure to 👍 LIKE THE GAME and ⭐ FAVORITE!

🎁 Use code UPDATE1 for a free Class Spin!
